groups.why_chosen: A client can pipeline a causally-dependent second transaction immediately after a speculative outcome for the first, without waiting for finality; if the process later reports that speculation was stale, the client resubmits at a later round instead of stalling on every request.
groups.what_to_learn: a two-lane (server/client) swimlane with round-indexed sub-phase boxes on one lane, crossed by numbered, differently-coloured arrows tracing a speculate-then-correct message exchange
